description:
Welcome to Jefferson Haus! Experience downtown views from every floor – our 4‑story luxury home features two living areas, a game room and a private rooftop lounge. Located near the heart of Germantown, and just a little over a mile from Broadway and the city’s iconic music scene. This brand-new home offers spectacular city VIEWS FROM EVERY FLOOR. Best of all, Jefferson Haus is just a short walk away from fabulous restaurants and the lively nightlife that Germantown is known for.

The space
Our 4-story townhome offers 4 bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms, with two living spaces and a spectacular roof deck and a game room!

Guest access
The entire home. (All four floors.)
